description:
The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India aimed at enhancing urban infrastructure and improving the quality of life in cities. 

The scheme was launched on June 25, 2021. 

It is named after former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. 

The primary objective of the Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is to promote sustainable urban development. 

The scheme focuses on improving the livability index of cities. 

It aims to enhance urban infrastructure in a systematic and planned manner. 

The government has set measurable targets for the scheme. 

One of the key goals is to ensure that at least 100 cities are developed under this initiative by 2025. 

The scheme also aims to improve the urban governance framework. 

It seeks to enhance the participation of citizens in urban planning and development. 

The benefits of the Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna include financial assistance to urban local bodies. 

The government allocates funds based on the population of the cities involved. 

Cities with a population of over one million can receive up to INR 100 crore. 

Cities with a population between 5 lakh to 10 lakh can receive up to INR 50 crore. 

For cities with a population below 5 lakh, the assistance can be up to INR 25 crore. 

The scheme also includes capacity building for urban local bodies. 

This involves training and workshops to enhance the skills of municipal staff. 

The eligibility criteria for cities to participate in the scheme are specific. 

Only urban local bodies that are registered under the Municipal Act are eligible. 

The cities should have a well-defined urban development plan. 

They must also demonstrate a commitment to sustainable practices. 

The application process for the Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna involves several steps. 

Urban local bodies must submit a detailed project proposal. 

This proposal should outline the intended improvements and expected outcomes. 

The proposal must include a budget breakdown and timelines for implementation. 

Required documents include proof of registration under the Municipal Act. 

Cities must also provide evidence of existing urban development plans. 

Once the proposal is submitted, it is reviewed by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. 

The ministry assesses the feasibility and alignment with the scheme's objectives. 

Upon approval, funds are disbursed in installments based on project milestones. 

The timeline for the implementation of projects under this scheme is flexible. 

However, projects are expected to be completed within a maximum of two years. 

Regular monitoring and evaluation are conducted to ensure compliance. 

The implementing authority for the Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. 

The ministry is responsible for overseeing the execution of the scheme. 

They also provide technical assistance to urban local bodies. 

Contact details for the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs can be found on their official website. 

The scheme encourages innovative solutions for urban challenges. 

It promotes the use of technology in urban planning and management. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna also emphasizes environmental sustainability. 

It encourages cities to adopt green building practices and renewable energy sources. 

The scheme aims to improve public transportation systems in urban areas. 

It also focuses on enhancing waste management and sanitation facilities. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 10,000 crore for this initiative. 

This budget is intended to cover various projects across the selected cities. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is part of the larger Smart Cities Mission. 

This mission aims to create smart urban spaces through integrated development. 

The scheme also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

It aims to ensure inclusive and sustainable urbanization. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is expected to create job opportunities in urban areas. 

It will also enhance the overall economic development of the cities involved. 

The scheme encourages public-private partnerships for project implementation. 

This collaboration is intended to leverage additional resources and expertise. 

The government aims to create a framework for continuous improvement in urban governance. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is a step towards achieving a more sustainable urban future. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the quality of life for urban residents. 

The scheme also aims to reduce urban poverty and inequality. 

It promotes social inclusion and community participation in urban development. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is a comprehensive approach to urban challenges. 

It addresses issues such as housing, transportation, and public services. 

The scheme is expected to have a long-lasting impact on urban areas in India. 

It aims to create cities that are not only livable but also resilient to climate change. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is a crucial initiative in India's urban development strategy. 

It represents a significant investment in the future of Indian cities. 

The government continues to monitor the progress of the scheme closely. 

Regular updates and reports are published to keep stakeholders informed. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is a vital component of India's vision for urban transformation. 

It embodies the principles of sustainable development and good governance. 

The scheme is designed to empower local governments to take charge of urban development. 

It encourages a holistic approach to addressing urban challenges. 

The Atal Shresth Shahar Yojna is an important step towards creating smart and sustainable cities in India.
